purpose: Every MCP tool name a skill may cite in backticks. scripts/validate-skills.py errors on a backticked snake_case tool-shaped token that is neither here nor in notTools. The registered set is the FullAccess tools/list capture of MCP 0.4.4; names an older, narrower server carried but 0.4.4 does not register are listed under notRegisteredOn044 and must not be cited as tools.

mcp-0.4.4-fullaccess.note: the FullAccess tool set of MCP 0.4.4 as returned by tools/list, and the ONLY registered set. A key with narrower permissions lists a subset, so a name missing from a running server is a permission question before it is an existence question. 0.4.4 serves the PLURAL batch getters (get_pages_by_ids, get_products_by_ids, get_users_by_ids) and registers no singular by-id getter for pages, products or users; the payment and shipping families are method-scoped (create_shipping_method, save_payment_methods, copy_payment_method), so take each name from this list rather than applying a rename rule.

optional-add-in.mcpVersion: not in the standard tool set
optional-add-in.note: tools no captured tools/list registers. They ship, if at all, in an optional migration add-in on top of the standard Dynamicweb MCP add-in. A skill citing one states that availability is build-dependent and names what the reader does when tools/list does not carry it.

notRegisteredOn044.note: seen on an older, narrower server and ABSENT from the 0.4.4 FullAccess tools/list. Kept here as a lookup so a name that reads plausible is recognised as retired rather than re-cited. This list and tools/list are the only test of whether a name is registered: an unregistered name answers 'Access denied' naming whatever permission the tool DECLARES, which is sometimes 'none' and sometimes a real permission such as 'Create', so the error text is evidence neither way.
